scope: focused same-model runtime feature qualification; no speed or full-context concurrency claim
sequence: record host memory and router/native idle; quiesce/drain primary-local
retain exact baseline container, verify stopped restoration preview
load candidate through recipe; inspect health/build identity/startup
smoke/json/20 tools/tool continuation/streaming/image; C4 exact canaries under telemetry sampler
cold and warm synthetic 19k/99k retrieval; long structured map
prompt/reply logprobs combined TP2 and exact repeat; no-tool history streamed/whole
managed restart candidate and first-inference cache recovery
unload candidate; restore exact baseline, readmit and routed preflight; no alias or policy edit
stop_rules: startup/resource/identity/counter inconsistency: preserve error/logs then restore baseline
quality failure: stop broad campaign, retain actual response and independent mismatch
no silent retry or alternative model

metrics_coverage.C4: quality canaries plus sampled occupancy/memory/partition accounting
metrics_coverage.KV_pool_reply_cap: CPU edge cases; deployed pool exceeds request context, clipping incidence not forced
metrics_coverage.tool_guard: host parser adversarial tests plus live synthetic history; emission of rejected markup is not guaranteed
metrics_coverage.EOS: startup token validation plus bounded nonrepeated outputs; model emission not guaranteed
metrics_coverage.cache: fresh candidate volume and same-volume restart

promotion: conditionally authorized by user: meaningful benefit and remaining gates pass

review_resolution.candidate_custody: managed exact image/recipe/port/container checks added before and after delta tests
review_resolution.guard: history regression smoke only; host parser tests cover rejection/hiding
review_resolution.raw_response: explicitly unvalidated until success receipt; failed exit retained; no overwrite/retry

launcher: python -m anvil_serving.cli with frozen worktree PYTHONPATH
additional_tests: baseline128 logprob refusal vs candidate128 requested IDs/repeat/129 refusal
bounded truncated-tool transport: chat and messages, whole and streamed; inspect actual emitted path
requested IDs outside top128 scored distinctly; count129 refused; two score plus one plain shared wave
optional_tunes: L2PF and THINK_OFF_SPLIT remain disabled; no speed claim
